table_revision: 2 (DECISIONS A24-4, correction r33.restart-cost-price-base-2025): restart costs restated from 2024 GBP to the model's 2025 price base
status: AUTHOR REVIEWED (DECISIONS A22, 2026-10-07); price base converted per DECISIONS A24-4 (2026-10-07)
acceptance: DECISIONS A22: CCGT hot/warm/cold restart GBP 110/130/150 per MW chosen by the expected downtime H (< 12 h hot, 12-48 h warm, > 48 h cold); OCGT GBP 170 per MW (wear plus start-up fuel and carbon, the same basis as the other technologies); biomass GBP 125 per MW; minimum stable generation CCGT 50 %, OCGT 50 %, biomass 35 %; minimum down time 6 h / 0.5 h / 6 h. H = (number of consecutive surplus periods of the day-ahead forecast from the current period) x 0.5 h; a unit may enter the shutdown segment only when H >= its minimum down time. The A22 values are 2024 GBP (restart_cost_gbp2024_per_mw); DECISIONS A24-4 restates them in the price base of the model's cost parameters, the same basis as the fuel and carbon prices (restart_cost_gbp_per_mw, 2025 GBP, price_base).
applies_to: value-corrected profile only: the default PSM (correction r12.economic-downward-order, decisions A19, A22, A22a) and the network models' dec order (r32.network-economic-downward-order, decision A24-3). The doctoral profile keeps the thesis curtail-cost order (Q1).
compiled_from: docs/dev/REFERENCE_STATISTICS_FOR_AUTHOR_REVIEW.md section 4 (unit R1-1; values 4.5, conversion 4.2, per-MWh comparison 4.6)
price_basis: 2025 GBP per MW of capacity per start (restart_cost_gbp_per_mw). Built from wear (Kumar et al. 2012 median, lower bound) plus start-up fuel and carbon (Staffell & Green 2015, GB), converted to 2024 GBP with Bank of England annual exchange rates and the ONS CPI (reference statistics 4.2), then to 2025 GBP by price_base.factor (reference statistics 4.2a). The model's money is constant base-year GBP, undiscounted (DECISIONS A6: every amount in start-year money).

price_base.index: ONS CPI INDEX 00: ALL ITEMS (D7BT, 2015=100), annual average (R11)
price_base.factor_rule: factor = index_to_year / index_from_year; restart_cost_gbp_per_mw = round(restart_cost_gbp2024_per_mw x index_to_year / index_from_year, 1)
price_base.base_year_evidence: 2025 is the start year of every shipped study (R029 2025-2034, VALUE 101 2025-2026, GBP1 2025), the year in which DECISIONS A6 states all money, and the declared base year of the model's dated cost inputs (storage_technology_catalogue.json currency_base_year 2025; pumped-hydro CAPEX and the policy budgets in 2025 GBP, methodology core.md and r029_cem.md). The fuel and carbon prices (fleet fuel_cost, carbon_price per MWh) carry no price year of their own and are, by A6, start-year (2025) money.
price_base.verification: The 2024 annual average (133.9) was read on the ONS series page by unit R1-1 (2026-10-07, [V]). The 2025 annual average (138.4) is the mean of the twelve 2025 monthly D7BT values as known to unit R3-3, which had no web access; it was not re-read online ([NV], reference statistics 4.2a). An error of 0.1 index point moves every value by 0.07 % (under GBP 0.2 per MW).

rule.running_range: Output above min_stable_fraction x the asset's online capacity is reduced without a restart: its cost of reduction is minus the avoided short-run cost c (fuel + carbon + unit_time_cost (VOM) + base, i.e. gen_cost), so it is always cheaper than curtailing VRE (cost 0).
rule.online_capacity: The aggregate fleet has no commitment state; its online capacity in a period is its accepted day-ahead output of that period (units scheduled day-ahead are online and fully loaded).
rule.shutdown_segment: Output below min_stable_fraction x online capacity (down to the ramp floor) needs units to shut down and restart later at S per MW of capacity; at minimum stable generation m, removing 1 MW of output shuts 1/m MW of capacity: net saving per MWh a(H) = c - S(H) / (m H) (DECISIONS A22a). a > 0: reduced before VRE (in descending a); a <= 0: after VRE; H < min_down_time_h: not allowed while any other down regulation is left (last resort).

CCGT.grades: restart: R1 wear 31/49/71 [E] + R3 fuel and carbon 80 [E] (2024 GBP); min stable: R4/R5 45 %, R6 50 %, Elexon SEL/MEL 47-60 % [V]; min down: Elexon MZT 360 min [V] (literature 1-2 h)

OCGT.grades: restart: R1 wear 29 [E] + R3 fuel and carbon 140 [E] (2024 GBP; warm/cold [NV], equal to hot); min stable: R6 50 % [E] (R5 20 %, one Elexon unit 90 %); min down: one period (Elexon MZT 20 min [V], R5 0)
